title: SynthCorp: A Platform for Creating Benchmarks for Data Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.14765v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Current benchmarks for LLM-driven data agents saturate quickly and cannot target specific capabilities. We present SynthCorp, a platform that creates customizable data estates and benchmarks by simulating how business events produce and modify corporate data over time. Each data estate combines relational databases, a document store, and a data catalog, paired with evaluation tasks and executable gold programs. First, given a scenario and target complexity dimensions, SynthCorp synthesizes reusable event types and compiles each into a program over predefined simulation primitives. Second, SynthCorp schedules event instances on a virtual calendar, interleaving routine and disruption events so that tables, documents, and catalog entries remain consistent. Third, SynthCorp executes the calendar to materialize the data estate and records every operation in a simulation log. Fourth, SynthCorp generates analytical tasks and derives verified go

translated_title: SynthCorp：一个用于创建数据智能体基准测试的平台
translated_abstract: 当前针对大语言模型（LLM）驱动的数据智能体的基准测试很快就会饱和，且无法针对特定能力进行评估。我们提出了SynthCorp，这是一个通过模拟业务事件如何随时间产生和修改企业数据，来创建可定制数据资产和基准测试的平台。每个数据资产结合了关系数据库、文档存储和数据目录，并配有评估任务和可执行的黄金程序。首先，给定一个场景和目标复杂度维度，SynthCorp合成可重用的事件类型，并将每个事件类型编译为基于预定义仿真原语的程序。其次，SynthCorp在虚拟日历上调度事件实例，交替安排常规事件和干扰事件，使表、文档和目录条目保持一致。第三，SynthCorp执行日历以实体化数据资产，并在仿真日志中记录每个操作。第四，SynthCorp生成分析任务并推导出经过验证的黄金（程序）……
tldr: SynthCorp是一个通过模拟业务事件随时间演变来生成可定制数据资产与基准测试的平台，解决了现有LLM数据智能体基准测试快速饱和且无法针对特定能力评估的问题。
en_tdlr: SynthCorp is a platform that creates customizable data estates and benchmarks by simulating how business events produce and modify corporate data over time, addressing the rapid saturation and lack of capability targeting in current LLM data agent benchmarks.
